text:
ara: quick Q — where are the prod EU logs for model `redwood/gpt-3x`? I need to isolate 5xx on route `/generate` for org `acme`. anyone have a saved search or dashboard link?
jamie: try Observability -> Logs (LogSearch). i usually run: `org:acme AND model:redwood/gpt-3x AND route:/generate AND status:[500 TO 599]` then set timeframe to last 1h.
pri: I made a saved search yesterday for this pattern. name = `acme/gen-route-5xx-eu`. link: https://console.redwood.ai/observability/logs/view/SS-7f4b2 (will require org access).
sam: if you want traces for error spikes, go to Traces -> filter `service:inference AND tag.model:gpt-3x AND http.route:/generate` and check spans with error=true.
ara: thanks! pri, can you share the saved-search id or pin it to eng-sre dashboard? i can't find it in my saved lists.
pri: sure — ID `SS-7f4b2`. pinned it to the eng-ops dashboard and shared with `eng-sre` team. should be visible here: https://console.redwood.ai/observability/dashboards/eng-ops?panel=logs
logsearch-bot: saved-search `SS-7f4b2` created by pri at 2026-03-17T10:12:03Z (meta: org=acme, model=redwood/gpt-3x, route=/generate, status=5xx).
jamie: if you want a one-click filter, import this snippet into LogSearch quick filter:```query: org:acme
model:redwood/gpt-3x
route:/generate
status:[500 TO 599]
``` then Save -> give a name -> Share -> Team.
ara: perfect, created a saved alias `acme-gen-5xx-now`. thanks all :thumbsup:
pri: FYI, alert tuning request open in #incidents (1759001123) to suppress noisy 502s from vendor timeouts — that should reduce the alert volume for this saved search.
sam: heads up — if you narrow by `node_region:eu-west-1` you'll only see EU infra hits. saved query supports adding that field.
ara: awesome, closing this. will ping if i need a deeper dig.
jamie: np — ping @pri or @sam for dashboard access or help with trace joins.
